searchText: Hey Guys - from DAppNode we'd be super keen on helping or being involved. I'm not sure how exactly I can collaborate but I will keep an eye in here. Unfortunately, the technical people's bandwidth is pretty full right now so I can only offer non-technical help (maybe not super useful at this stage). One of the things I can think of is to make DAppNode packages of the merge testnets to try in our userbase's hardware I'll keep the antenna in here to see how we can get more involved :😊 Update <@!203220829473996800> and <@!425572898787426305>: https://github.com/rauljordan/eth-faucet faucet is complete now. Fully configurable and comes with a ready React and a ready Angular project as reference It is also dockerized This is great as I am going to update a localnet with recent Teku+Catalyst, it uses docker-compose and I will be able to test faucet there Created a specific guide for Rayonism participants to get started with Prysm for the hackathon https://hackmd.io/@prysmaticlabs/prysm-rayonism
